title: Fix gateway timeout unit mismatch
description: The gateway reads config.yaml timeout as milliseconds, while the intended client timeout is 30 seconds. Set the configuration value to 30000 milliseconds so requests do not time out after 30ms.
close_reason: Updated config.yaml timeout from 30 to 30000 milliseconds, preserving the intended 30-second timeout.

title: Fix Docker npm install working directory and lockfile
description: The Docker image copies the project into /app but runs npm ci from /, so the lockfile is not found. Add the generated lockfile and run build commands from the application directory.
close_reason: Added a lockfile, run npm in /app, exclude host node_modules, and make the optional build step pass; docker build succeeds.

title: Fix /users query returning 500
description: The /users handler uses invalid SQL syntax (FORM instead of FROM), causing the database query to fail and the endpoint to return 500. Correct the SQL keyword and verify the handler.
close_reason: Corrected the invalid SQL keyword from FORM to FROM; node syntax and diff checks pass.

title: Fix /users SQL query returning 500
description: The /users handler uses the invalid SQL keyword FORM instead of FROM, causing database query failures and HTTP 500 responses. Correct the query and verify the endpoint.
close_reason: Corrected FORM to FROM in the /users SQL query; syntax check passes.
